Start with a local simulated API or bring your own endpoint.

Saved collection

Accepts Postman v2, Swagger 2.0, OpenAPI 3.x (JSON/YAML) and ReleaseRadar collections. Import is local and does not send requests.

Imported requests stay in memory until refresh. Saved templates stay in this browser. Headers, bodies and URL queries are removed when saving. Environment values stay in memory.

Request studio

02
Environment & headers
Request body
Assertions

Supported types: status, time (milliseconds), contains, json (dot path and exact value).

Relay sends your URL, headers and body through ReleaseRadar to public HTTP(S) APIs on ports 80/443. Private hosts, IP literals, invalid TLS and automatic redirects are not supported. Credentials you enter are forwarded only to the chosen endpoint; the app does not store relay payloads. 30 requests/minute per visitor; 1,000/day site-wide. Demo URLs are simulated locally.
